summary: Approved. The Builder changes are acceptable for the requested Rerun camera/frustum fix based on static review: camera pose, trajectory, and light direction use the same Unreal-to-Rerun axis conversion and meter scale; camera images are under the pinhole entity; and RGB/normal/diffuse visualization handling is explicit. No Builder follow-up is required before live user validation.
work_completed: Reviewed examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py for coordinate conversion, pose/frustum logging, image entity paths, and image color handling.
Reviewed examples/flashlight/README.md for consistency with the new Rerun stream paths and validation caveat.

Checked official Rerun API reference snippets for Pinhole/ViewCoordinates arguments used by the implementation: https://ref.rerun.io/docs/python/main/common/archetypes/ and https://ref.rerun.io/docs/python/0.26.1/common/components/.

findings.message: examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:54-58,156-191,298-323: The Unreal-to-Rerun conversion is internally consistent for the reviewed outputs. Locations are axis-swapped and scaled from Unreal centimeters to Rerun meters, while orientation and light direction vectors use the same axis conversion without distance scaling. The resulting identity-camera basis maps to Rerun RDF camera axes in a right-handed Z-up world.

examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:302-314: The pinhole and transform are logged at `spear/camera`, and RGB, depth, world-normal visualization, and diffuse visualization are direct children under `spear/camera/...`, which is the expected hierarchy for Rerun to associate images/depth with that pinhole.

examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:194-223,310-314: Color handling is reasonable for the requested sane visualization behavior. Final tone curve BGR/BGRA data is converted to RGB/RGBA before `rr.Image`, world normals are mapped from [-1, 1] to uint8 false color, and diffuse color is clipped and gamma corrected before logging as RGB.

Live SPEAR/Rerun validation was not run, per task constraints. Local construction of Rerun archetypes also could not be exercised because this environment lacks `numpy`, `spear`, and `rerun`; validation was limited to static review, official Rerun API docs, and py-compile.

follow_up_recommendations: Run the documented live `run_programmatic_rerun.py` command in an environment with SPEAR, numpy, and rerun-sdk installed to visually confirm frustum scale, RGB projection placement, depth projection, and color appearance in the viewer.
